setup: CREATE VIEW vwItemCategory AS SELECT Item.id, Item.name, Category.catName FROM Item JOIN Category ON Category.id = Item.categoryId

CREATE VIEW vwInvoiceDetails AS SELECT Invoice.id AS invoiceId, Invoice.clientId, Client.name, Client.surname, Cashier.name AS cashierName, Invoice.total FROM Invoice JOIN Client ON Client.id = Invoice.clientId JOIN Cashier ON Cashier.id = Invoice.cashierId
